BREAKING — Kevin Alonso Valdez was arrested Tuesday at noon, October 20, 2026, on two felony charges — theft of property valued between $30,000 and $150,000, and unauthorized use of a vehicle — according to Webb County booking records.

Valdez was booked into the Webb County Jail on one count of theft of property valued at $30,000 or more but less than $150,000 — a third-degree felony under Texas law — and one count of unauthorized use of a vehicle — a state jail felony. Bonds were set at $20,000 on the theft charge and $10,000 on the unauthorized-use charge. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Under Texas law, theft of property valued at $30,000 or more but less than $150,000 is a third-degree felony, punishable by 2 to 10 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000. Unauthorized use of a vehicle — operating someone else's motor vehicle without the owner's consent — is a state jail felony, punishable by 180 days to 2 years in a state jail facility and a fine of up to $10,000.

Webb Watch 956 will follow this case as it moves through the Webb County courts — whether the charges hold, are reduced, or are dismissed is now a matter for the court record.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Kevin Alonso Valdez is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Oct. 20, 2026); Webb County public-access court records, Tyler Odyssey portal.

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956
